title: A code task carries the kb/_self docs that describe it
goal: backlog.py check warns when an open item's touches name files under _tools/, .claude/, .claude-plugin/ or .gitlab-ci.yml whose kb/_self/map.csv docs are in no item's touches, or only in a later task's touches (one that depends on it), naming the docs, and /kb-backlog and /kb-sprint plan put a code change's doc lines in the same task, as kb/_self/git.md asks; planted items in test_backlog.py show both warnings. Failures it answers: in SP-liemltg2 selfdoc stale flagged tools.md and plugin.md on docs outside every touches; in SP-aikswrrl the route docs sat in docs tasks that depended on later code, and the orchestrator wrote four docs commits outside any item.
